data.description: A high school gymnasium converted into an emergency shelter during a crisis. The basketball court is lined with cots. Handwritten signs direct people to MEDICINE, MEALS, and MESSAGES stations. A folding table serves as an operations desk where updates are recorded on a whiteboard. A tabletop radio provides communication with field teams.
data.name: High School Gym Shelter
data.narrative_significance: The High School Gym Shelter serves as the emergency operations and coordination hub during a disaster evacuation. It functions as the central point for resource distribution (medicine, meals, messages), information management, and communication with field teams. The shelter represents community resilience and the human element of crisis response, as evidenced by the decision to broadcast a missing pet announcement alongside critical infrastructure updates.
